component.name: Colosseum
component.summary: Chess engine testing suite with live tournament results

description.p: Colosseum runs engine-vs-engine chess tournaments and shows live results. Add UCI engines, configure a round-robin tournament with a time control, then watch the sortable standings table update after every game.

ul.li: Engine library: add one or scan a folder; auto-detects UCI options
Round-robin with configurable concurrency and time control
Live results: Elo Δ, points, W/D/L, head-to-head matrix, avg NPS
Opening books: EPD or PGN files, sequential or random order
PGN export; tournament history; resume after interruption
